questionText:
Read the following passage carefully and answer the questions that follow:

CraftVillas Ltd. designs bespoke solid-wood modular furniture crafted by master artisans in Rajasthan. Initially, the company operated through a traditional three-level distribution channel: Manufacturer -> C&F Agents -> Wholesalers -> Independent Furniture Retailers -> End Consumers. However, the management observed serious drawbacks: markups charged by each intermediary inflated the final retail price by over 60%, delicate handcrafted dining tables suffered extensive transit breakage during repeated unloading across warehouses, and valuable consumer feedback regarding modular designs never reached the factory artisans. To regain control over customer experience, CraftVillas dismantled this multi-tier channel. It adopted a direct zero-level channel (Direct Marketing), launching an experiential digital showroom website and opening company-owned flagship experience studios in top metro cities, delivering assembled furniture directly to homeowners using dedicated cushioned logistics vans.

questionText:
Match List–I with List–II
List–I (Importance of
Organising)
List–II (Description)
(A) Benefits of
specialisation
(I) Stimulating creativity amongst the managers
(B) Clarity in working
relationships
(II) Systematic allocation of jobs amongst the
workforce
(C) Development of
personnel
(III) Removing ambiguity in the transfer of
information and instructions
(D) Expansion and
growth
(IV) Helping in the diversification of an enterprise
Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Correctly maps each entity across columns.
Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.
Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.
Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
1. Match (A) Benefits of specialisation: Derived from systematic allocation of jobs among workforce -> (II).
2. Match (B) Clarity in working relationships: Eliminates ambiguity and defines lines of communication -> (III).
3. Match (C) Development of personnel: Encourages managerial initiative and stimulates creativity via delegation -> (I).
4. Match (D) Expansion and growth: Enables corporate diversification and entry into new products/markets -> (IV).
5. Composite pairing: (A) - (II), (B) - (III), (C) - (I), (D) - (IV).
6. This matches Option B.
Hence, option (A) is the correct match.
